optional.without_it: inventory facts are unknown; offload and verify do not need it
--hash xxh64 is refused (HASH_UNAVAILABLE, nothing written); sha256 + c4 need only the standard library
fetch is refused (FETCH_UNAVAILABLE, nothing written); offload, verify and inventory do not need it

execution.overwrites: never: identical files are skipped, different ones are conflicts

never_recorded: credentials in URLs (userinfo, token / signature / key / password-like parameters)

not_provided: deleting or formatting the source card
ASC MHL directory / root hashes, rename, flatten and collections (not yet)
recording a verify run as an ASC MHL generation (verify writes nothing)
authenticated downloads (cookies, logins, .netrc, browser cookies) and DRM-protected media (never circumvented)
playlists and channels (fetch takes the URL of one video)
Panasonic P2, Canon XF and RED card structures (their media are listed file by file, as generic)
interpreting AVCHD clip-info (.CPI) or Blackmagic RAW .sidecar contents (listed with their clip, not read)
grouping a recording continued on another card (each card is inventoried on its own)

tools.description: Copy every file of a card or recorder folder to one or more destinations (the source is read once per file, written to every destination in parallel), verified by a sha256 (default) or xxh64 read-back of each; writes ingest-manifest.json and an ASC MHL history generation (ascmhl/) in each
Re-hash an offloaded folder against its manifest (sha256 or xxh64) and its ASC MHL history: missing, changed and unlisted files; writes nothing

Clip list of a card or an offloaded folder, one entry per recording: card structure (Sony XDCAM / XAVC, XDCAM EX, AVCHD, Blackmagic RAW, generic), spanned files grouped in order, camera sidecar metadata, reel / card id, manifest hash and ffprobe facts

Download one video URL with yt-dlp (optional extra) into a staging folder, then offload it to every destination exactly like a card (verified copies, ingest-manifest.json, ASC MHL history); the manifest records the source URL (credentials redacted), the extractor, the yt-dlp version, the format id and the time
